description.en: Advances the game's story sub-phase: fades the screen out (with an optional map-effect fade), replaces NPCs, sets the new sub-phase, updates and waits for the objective/purpose message to load, optionally plays the purpose jingle effect, runs the inatter (background-loading) check, waits for NPC replacement to finish, then fades the screen back in.
New game sub-phase value to set.
Whether to play the purpose-update jingle/flash effect for this transition.
Optional fade-out duration in frames (defaults to 15.0).
Optional fade-in duration in frames; a negative value skips the fade-in, e.g. before a map jump (defaults to 15.0).
Optional screen buffer to fade (defaults to SCREEN_AB).
Optional jingle sound event ID for the purpose effect (defaults to "J_10").
Optional; whether to suppress the BGM fade during the purpose jingle (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Advance to a new game sub-phase with the purpose effect and default fades
SetGameSubPhase(10040020, true);
